findings.claim: node --test --test-reporter=spec on Node >=22.12 also prints 'suites 0', 'cancelled 0', 'skipped 0', 'todo 0' and 'duration_ms <ms>' lines, but this expected file stops at tests/pass/fail while README.md line 121 claims the output 'matches expected/on-completion.txt, apart from the timings'; the accepted html-and-css lab's expected file includes the full info block.
findings.recommendation: Append the missing info lines (suites 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0, duration_ms <ms>) in reporter order, as in html-css-js/html-and-css/coding-lab/expected/on-completion.txt.

findings.claim: The source-scan sanitizer strips // comments before string literals (same pattern in dom-tooling-and-async tests/dashboard.test.mjs lines 11-14), so a string literal containing '//' (e.g. "http://localhost") truncates the rest of that line and leaves an unterminated quote that corrupts subsequent string stripping, and template literals spanning multiple lines are never stripped (the string regex excludes newline), so 'var' or '==' appearing as prose inside such a learner-written template false-trips the task 1 style checks.
findings.recommendation: Strip strings and comments in one combined alternation so string contents win over comment markers, which also covers multi-line template literals.
